hero.title: Ilias Laoukili
hero.description: Building RAG and GNN systems at the intersection of AI and applied research, with active work at LAMA (Université Gustave Eiffel) and an upcoming R&D internship at Nanyang Polytechnic.

introduction.content: I am an AI & Cybersecurity Engineering Student at ESIEE Paris and Research Assistant at Université Gustave Eiffel, investigating graph sparsification for GNNs. This summer I will be at Nanyang Polytechnic in Singapore, building a RAG system to make EnergyPlus energy simulation accessible via natural language. My work spans Graph Neural Networks, Digital Signal Processing, and applied AI. I also volunteer with the French Red Cross.
